CardPayment extends Payment; its binding may access inherited features. Bind subtype-only features through CardPayment; a type-test branch alone does not narrow a base-typed OCL binding in this backend.

CashPayment extends Payment; its binding may access inherited features. Bind subtype-only features through CashPayment; a type-test branch alone does not narrow a base-typed OCL binding in this backend.
OrderStatus: use only OrderStatus::NEW, OrderStatus::RECEIVED, OrderStatus::REQUESTED. Preserve source spellings; do not introduce aliases.
Parameter address: String. Reference it as address, not self.address; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter id: Integer. Reference it as id, not self.id; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter isopened: Boolean. Reference it as isopened, not self.isopened; preserve its declared name and type.
Parameter name: String. Reference it as name, not self.name; preserve its declared name and type.
Service state self.CurrentCashDesk: CashDesk. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
Service state self.CurrentStore: Store. Access it through self; the model declaration does not itself require changing it.
The operation returns Boolean. Use result only in the postcondition, with a compatible value satisfying the stated return obligation; do not assume a Boolean result is true.
